Having found the emblem, report back to the Scrying Pool.

== Objectives ==
* Investigate the tarnished emblem at the [[scrying pool]].

== Rewards ==
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]]

== Dialogue ==
=== Initial dialogue ===
;Tarnished Emblem
''Something on the ground catches your eye. It is faint, covered in dirt, and stained with old blood. Closer inspection reveals it to be the tarnished emblem of a high-ranking White Mantle member. What happened here? Perhaps the scrying pool can provide further answers.''
{{offer dialog
|accept = I need to know what happened here.
|decline = An important White Mantle member died. That happens all the time.
|ask = The site offers no further clues as to what transpired here.}}

=== Reward dialogue ===
;Scrying Pool
:''"The scrying pool begins to react as you approach, thoughts of the tarnished emblem fixed firmly in your mind."''

== Notes ==
* The [[Tarnished Emblem]] is located at the resurrection shrine as you enter [[Majesty's Rest]] from [[Sage Lands]].
* This quest is part of [[Hearts of the North]], the second installment in [[Guild Wars Beyond]].
